subject: Extended 503 regression - request for incident window confirmation, evidence, and RCA
messages:
From: Danielle Murphy <danielle.murphy@finservco.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: sudden 503s this morning - impact to batch scoring

Hi Evelyn / Marissa,

We started seeing elevated 503s against the Redwood hosted inference endpoint this morning starting ~09:05 PST and lasting in waves through ~09:47 PST. The failures primarily affected our end-of-day batch scoring job (approx 150k requests) and caused a downstream retry storm in our pipeline.

We captured client-side logs showing 503 responses and increased latency spikes (p50 ~240ms, p95 ~1.2s during the window). Can you confirm whether Redwood saw an outage or elevated error rate in us-west-2 during that window? We need:
- confirmation of any service interruption and exact incident window
- per-route error rates and any root cause notes you can share
- guidance on SLA credit eligibility and expected timeline for an RCA

Attached is a small excerpt from our logs that shows timestamps and request IDs (support_logs_excerpt.log). Happy to jump on a short call if that's faster. This incident caused a missed batch for our downstream analytics job, so timely confirmation would be much appreciated.

Thanks,
Danielle Murphy
Head of Data Engineering
FinServCo
Attachment: support_logs_excerpt.log (text, 48KB)

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Murphy <danielle.murphy@finservco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: sudden 503s this morning - impact to batch scoring

Hi Danielle — thanks for the heads up and for sending the excerpt.

Short answer: we saw elevated 5xx rates in us-west-2 at the same time window and are investigating. I’ve looped in Karthik from SRE/incident response (cc) to validate the precise window and pull server-side traces and metrics.

What I can commit to right now:
- We will validate the incident window and provide server-side error-rate graphs and request-id crosswalk to your client-side sample by EOD today (Nov 20).
- If the verified downtime meets our SLA credit conditions, we’ll open a compensation evaluation and follow the standard credit process (we’ll include the calculation and proposed credit amount).
- We’ll aim to have an initial RCA summary within 72 hours and a full postmortem within 7 business days.

Can you confirm whether you prefer the credit as a dollar-equivalent invoice credit or account usage credit? Also, please confirm a single contact for any PO/finance paperwork (name + email).

Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0187

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Danielle Murphy <danielle.murphy@finservco.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: sudden 503s this morning - initial triage notes

Evelyn / Marissa — forwarding customer report and my initial findings.

Triage summary (initial):
- Confirmed spike in 503s in us-west-2 control plane and serving layer from 09:03–09:50 PST; peak error rate ~13% (route: /v1/generate-batch).
- Correlated with an autoscaler churn event on the dedicated pool (scale-down followed by scale-up) that coincided with a misapplied health-check timeout (kube probe backoff) — causing a short period where backend pods were marked unhealthy and requests returned 503s.
- We collected pod logs and kube events; attaching a trimmed event snippet and aggregated request-id mapping for crosscheck.

Next steps I’m running now:
1) Produce a per-minute error-rate graph for the /v1/generate-batch route between 08:50–10:10 PST.
2) Generate a crosswalk of request IDs (server-side) to the IDs in Danielle's excerpt so they can validate.
3) Draft initial RCA blurb for Evelyn to send to the customer.

Attachments: kubernetes_event_snippet.txt; support_logs_20261120.zip (contains pod logs + request-id map).

--
Karthik Iyer
SRE Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Danielle Murphy <danielle.murphy@finservco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Incident confirmation, provisional credit eligibility, and next steps (FinServCo)

Hi Danielle — thanks for your patience while we completed the initial investigation. Below is a summary and next steps: 

Incident summary:
- Verified elevated 5xx responses in us-west-2 for route /v1/generate-batch between 2026-11-20T09:03:00-08:00 and 2026-11-20T09:50:30-08:00. Peak error rate ~13% across the dedicated pool.
- Root cause (initial): autoscaler churn + misconfigured kube liveness probe timeout that resulted in a transient backend unavailability window. Karthik's team has applied a fix to the probe timeout and adjusted autoscaler thresholds to prevent the same scale-down pattern.

Attachments provided: support_logs_20261120.zip (server-side request ID map and pod logs), kubernetes_event_snippet.txt (kube events around scale-down/scale-up).

Provisional credit eligibility:
- Based on the measured outage window and our SLA terms for hosted endpoints, this incident meets the threshold for a service credit evaluation. We will calculate the credit amount using the standard formula and share the proposed credit by EOD Nov 24.
- Please confirm whether you prefer: 
  * invoice credit (applied to next invoice)
  * account usage credit (added to account balance)

RCA and timeline:
- Initial RCA summary (one-page) is attached at the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cRCA-incident-doc
- Full postmortem (internal + customer-facing write-up) will be available by end of business on Dec 1 (target).

PO/finance contact
- You earlier asked about PO details — can you confirm the contact for finance to coordinate credits and any PO paperwork?

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call this week to walk through the logs and the temporary mitigations we applied.

Thanks again and apologies for the disruption.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment: incident_initial_rca.pdf (customer-facing summary, 2 pages)
